verdicts.reason: A breaks the layout into scattered pieces: '20% off' sits far below its eyebrow, and the body copy floats mid-canvas above and to the right of the headline, so it reads in the wrong order. The CTA is on its own random axis, and the legal line is shrunk to illegible micro-text under the circle. B keeps a clean left column (eyebrow, headline, copy, CTA, legal) with the can and circle on the right, which suits a banner. Its flaws are small: 'WEEKEND ONLY' is indented about 17 px past the column's left edge, the CTA sits tight under the copy, and the circle is cropped at the right and bottom edges.
